results.title: Three pages, one answer
results.text:
R-77 maps to Narvik. Now checking part 3 for the depot address.

The depot address is **Fagernesveien 118** in Narvik.

How I got there from the manual:
1. Part 1 says our crate carries route code **R-77**.
2. Part 2 says R-77 goes to **Narvik**.
3. Part 3 lists the Narvik depot at **Fagernesveien 118**.
